_notes: Every key is optional. 'intake' REPLACES the generic intake when present. Table and column names are matched case-insensitively. 'included' is one of: To Be Reviewed, Included, Not Included, Not Applicable. 'gated_by' names an intake topic whose Yes/No answer flips the table's inclusion. Intake rows can also use 'gates_classes' (e.g. ["Audit / History"]) to gate every table of a classification.
